findings.title: Unrecoverable dependency blocks dependent systems
findings.description: Orders Database (PostgreSQL) cannot be restored (cannot be restored: Backup encryption key disabled and pending deletion; recovery points cannot be decrypted). 3 dependent system(s) cannot return to service: app-erp, app-orders-api, web-storefront. app-orders-api have intact, eligible backups of their own, but restoring them alone is insufficient while this prerequisite is unavailable.
findings.business_impact: Tier 0 · Mission critical. 3 dependent system(s): Internal ERP, Orders API Service, Customer Storefront.
findings.calculation: Transitive dependents: 3; criticality-weighted impact: 11 (tier0=4, tier1=3, tier2=2, tier3=1).

recommendations.business_impact: Tier 0 · Mission critical. 3 dependent system(s): Internal ERP, Orders API Service, Customer Storefront.
recommendations.action: Restore or validate the critical dependency first (alternative recovery source, key recovery, or rebuild), then resume the dependent recovery.
recommendations.reason: Application recovery alone is insufficient when its prerequisites are lost.
recommendations.verification_procedure: Demonstrate a successful restore of the dependency in an isolated environment.
recommendations.expected_outcome: Dependency becomes restorable and dependents are unblocked.

recommendations.business_impact: Tier 0 · Mission critical. 3 dependent system(s): Internal ERP, Orders API Service, Customer Storefront.
recommendations.action: Establish a working backup for this asset and produce at least one integrity-verified recovery point in an isolated repository.
recommendations.reason: Without an eligible recovery point the asset cannot be restored after loss.
recommendations.verification_procedure: Run a backup job, record a passing integrity check, and confirm the point appears as eligible in RecoveryProof.
recommendations.expected_outcome: Asset shows an eligible recovery point and RP-001 is no longer raised.

recommendations.action: Reduce backup-administrator privileges: remove delete permissions from unapproved roles and require multi-party approval for deletion.
recommendations.reason: Every additional delete-capable role widens the blast radius of a credential compromise.
recommendations.verification_procedure: Perform an access review and record it as evidence.
recommendations.expected_outcome: Only approved roles can delete recovery points.

recommendations.business_impact: Tier 0 · Mission critical. 3 dependent system(s): Internal ERP, Orders API Service, Customer Storefront.
recommendations.action: Restore or validate this critical dependency with a full restore test and document its recovery runbook.
recommendations.reason: A failure here cascades to every dependent system.
recommendations.verification_procedure: Record a passing restore test for the dependency.
recommendations.expected_outcome: Dependency is restore-tested.

recommendations.business_impact: Tier 0 · Mission critical. 6 dependent system(s): Internal ERP, Orders API Service, Corporate File Storage, HR Self-Service Portal, Monitoring & Alerting, Customer Storefront.
recommendations.action: Investigate the contradiction between the backup platform and the evidence store; re-run verification.
recommendations.reason: Contradictions may indicate tampering, tooling faults or reporting errors.
recommendations.verification_procedure: Re-verify the recovery point and confirm reported status and evidence agree.
recommendations.expected_outcome: Reported status and evidence agree.

recommendations.business_impact: Tier 0 · Mission critical. 1 dependent system(s): Customer Storefront.
recommendations.action: Schedule and perform an end-to-end restore test into an isolated environment, including application-level validation.
recommendations.reason: Untested restores frequently fail on missing dependencies, keys, or runbook gaps.
recommendations.verification_procedure: Record the restore test result and measured duration as evidence.
recommendations.expected_outcome: Asset recovery evidence becomes 'Restore-tested' with a measured duration.

recommendations.action: Create an isolated backup copy in a separate account/tenant with compliance-mode immutability.
recommendations.reason: Ransomware operators routinely target backups reachable from production credentials.
recommendations.verification_procedure: Confirm a recovery point exists in the isolated repository and that its immutability configuration is evidenced.
recommendations.expected_outcome: Isolation status becomes 'verified'.

recommendations.business_impact: Tier 1 · Business critical. Potential data loss of 5 h exceeds tolerance by 1 h.
recommendations.action: Correct the backup schedule or failing jobs so that the backup interval is shorter than the RPO, and alert on missed backups.
recommendations.reason: Restoring from the newest eligible point would lose more data than the business has agreed to tolerate.
recommendations.verification_procedure: Review backup job logs for the last 7 days and confirm a verified recovery point exists within the RPO window.
recommendations.expected_outcome: Data-loss exposure is at or below the RPO.

recommendations.business_impact: Tier 1 · Business critical. Potential data loss of 2 h exceeds tolerance by 1 h.
recommendations.action: Correct the backup schedule or failing jobs so that the backup interval is shorter than the RPO, and alert on missed backups.
recommendations.reason: Restoring from the newest eligible point would lose more data than the business has agreed to tolerate.
recommendations.verification_procedure: Review backup job logs for the last 7 days and confirm a verified recovery point exists within the RPO window.
recommendations.expected_outcome: Data-loss exposure is at or below the RPO.

recommendations.action: Move critical recovery points to compliance-mode retention or remove bypass permissions from day-to-day administrator roles.
recommendations.reason: A compromised administrator could delete 'immutable' backups.
recommendations.verification_procedure: Review the repository policy and confirm bypass permissions are restricted to a break-glass role.
recommendations.expected_outcome: No standing role can bypass retention.

recommendations.business_impact: Tier 0 · Mission critical. 1 dependent system(s): Customer Storefront.
recommendations.action: Improve recovery-point retention to meet the policy minimum.
recommendations.reason: Short retention can leave only compromised points available after a long dwell time.
recommendations.verification_procedure: Confirm the retention setting and the oldest available recovery point.
recommendations.expected_outcome: Retention meets policy minimum.

recommendations.action: Investigate missing backup evidence and ensure verification results are exported to the evidence store.
recommendations.reason: Unsupported claims cannot be audited and may hide failed or skipped checks.
recommendations.verification_procedure: Locate or regenerate the evidence record and link it to the recovery point.
recommendations.expected_outcome: Claim is backed by an evidence record.

recommendations.action: Enable automated integrity verification (checksum/test mount) on every recovery point and store the results as evidence.
recommendations.reason: Backup existence is not proof of recoverability; unverified points cannot be relied on during an incident.
recommendations.verification_procedure: Confirm an integrity-check evidence record with result 'pass' exists for the newest point.
recommendations.expected_outcome: Newest point is integrity-verified and selected for recovery.

recommendations.action: Enable encryption at rest for backups using a managed key with restricted access, and document the configuration.
recommendations.reason: Unencrypted backups of sensitive data create a data-exposure risk if the repository is accessed.
recommendations.verification_procedure: Record an encryption-configuration evidence record.
recommendations.expected_outcome: Backup encryption is enabled and evidenced.

recommendations.action: Document a missing RTO and RPO with the business owner.
recommendations.reason: Without objectives, recovery cannot be prioritised or tested against a target.
